name: Call Sprite Swarm
text:
Frequency once per day

---
You erupt into a swarm of even tinier bodies or call up hidden compatriots from nearby, rallying countless sprites to a common cause. You become a swarm, returning to your normal form after 1 minute or by Dismissing the effect. While you're a swarm, you're immune to the Grabbed, Prone, and Restrained conditions, you have resistance 15 to slashing and piercing damage, and you have weakness 15 to area and splash damage. Your size becomes Large, you can occupy the same space as other creatures, and you can fit through any space a Tiny creature could. You can't speak, cast spells, use manipulate actions requiring your hands, activate your magic items, or make any of your Strikes with your normal body.

While you're a swarm, you can use a 2-action activity, which has the concentrate trait, to swarm over each creature that shares your space, dealing 8d6 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save save against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC.
